The '''pirate frigate''' was operated by [[Silvo's pirates]] in the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Real Adventure" /> It was equipped with multiple Turbolaser batteries and a large central hanger that could launch out pirate Snub fighters. Its destruction took place on At Attin, in an attempt to seize control of the planet’s [[At Attin Mint|mint]], by New Republic forces, which were contacted by [[Kh'ymm]]. Several fighters, including [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]]s, and [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter]]s, and a [[CR90 corvette]] arrived at [[At Attin]]. The Pirate Frigate soon crashed down on the planet’s surface, after a fatal blow to the rear top section of the frigate by a B-Wing's Composite-beam laser.

{{Ship-stub}}


==Behind the scenes==
The pirate frigate first appeared in the live-action television series ''[[Star Wars: Skeleton Crew]]'', making their [[in-universe]] debut in the first episode, "[[This Could Be a Real Adventure]],"<ref name="Real Adventure" /> which premiered on [[Disney+]] on [[December 2]], [[2024]].<ref name="Premiere">{{Twitter|StarWars|status/1861409832349172011|[[Star Wars]]|quote=Mark your calendars. 🗓️ On December 2, stream the two-episode series premiere of #SkeletonCrew, only on @DisneyPlus.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/QwMYe}}</ref> Before the premiere, starship was shown in the official trailer of the show, released on [[August 9]], 2024.<ref name="a6voXgBlmpk">{{SWYouTube|a6voXgBlmpk|Skeleton Crew | Official Trailer | Streaming December 3 on Disney+}}</ref> The design was done by [[Wikipedia:Concept Art|Concept artist]] [[Benjamin Last]] under the direction of [[Doug Chiang]], the series' design supervisor. Last shared concept art for the frigate on the website [[Wikiepedia:Art Station|Art Station]] as well as the original design brief including the idea of a massive ventral fin.<ref name="Last ArtStation">{{ArtStation|subdomain=blast|url=projects/dykXwx|name=[[Benjamin Last]]|text=Star Wars: Skeleton Crew Pirate Frigate|quote=Pirate Frigate design for Star Wars: Skeleton Crew. One of the more finished illustrations from my time designing this ship with the Lucasfilm Art Department. The brief called for a vessel built around a massive ventral fin, which pushed the design into this bold silhouette. After several early explorations, production ultimately landed on this version. Still a pinch-me moment getting to design another ship for the Star Wars universe under the direction of [[Doug Chiang]].|date=2024-09-30}}</ref>
